headline: Khaitan & Co, JSA act on Boldfit ₹400 crore Series B fundraise
sum: Bling Brands Private Limited, dba Boldfit, has raised ₹400 crore from a Series B fundraise led by The Wealth Company Alternates Trust – Bharat Value Fund. Khaitan & Co advised Boldfit on this fundraise.
detail: Bling Brands Private Limited, dba Boldfit, has raised ₹400 crore from a Series B fundraise led by The Wealth Company Alternates Trust – Bharat Value Fund. Khaitan & Co advised Boldfit on this fundraise. The Firm's scope of work involved negotiations, marking up, finalisation and execution of the transaction documents, and closing of the transaction. The transaction team consisted of Aniruddha Basu (Partner), Vivek Narayan (Principal Associate), Associates Insaf Ahamad T K, Anushka Rohilla and Shreya Srivastava.
